title: Reference vehicle
body: SUGGESTED BUILD restores the reference ship. LAUNCH unlocks when checks pass.

title: Trans-lunar injection
body: PROGRADE 3170 m/s. EXECUTE. Typing the number is faster than dragging.

title: Advance time
body: Click 10kx. Watch TARGET RANGE. Time advances only with warp.

title: Capture at closest approach
body: Closest approach pauses the sim. AUTO-PLAN fills the capture burn. Check PERIAPSIS, then EXECUTE.

title: Buy a hint
body: SOLVE -5 shows the exact burn for this phase: injection, capture, circularization or landing. Each hint costs 5 score points and trims contract payouts. NEXT cycles the free notes.

title: Circularize
body: AUTO-PLAN at an apsis circularizes. Prograde at apoapsis. Retrograde at periapsis.

title: Rewind
body: Checkpoints: launch, every burn, every approach, every 30 s. REWIND undoes a bad burn.

title: Transmit science
body: Inside 30,000 km, TRANSMIT SCIENCE. Check POWER first.

title: File the report
body: END files the report. Objectives, budget and propellant score. Progress autosaves.

title: Landing practice
body: One lesson left: a landing drill. Open LANDING PRACTICE from this screen.

title: Landing drill
body: This lander starts 2 km above the Moon, already falling. SUGGESTED BUILD restores it. LAUNCH starts the drill.

title: Free fall
body: Warp until SURFACE ALTITUDE is under 1 km. Gravity is your descent engine here.

title: Final brake
body: Set PROGRADE negative and brake. Keep RELATIVE SPEED under 40 m/s. Below 0.5 km, a full brake gives a soft touchdown.

title: File the drill
body: Touch down under 40 m/s. END files the report and completes Flight School.
